For the petitioner(s) : Mr. Vishal Kumar Rai, Advocate For the State : Mr. Nawin Kr. Singh, App
-----
02/09.06.2025:

This is an application filed by the petitioners praying for grant of anticipatory bail in terms of sections 482 and 484 of Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, as the petitioners have been allegedly implicated in connection with Complaint Case No. 31 of 2017 for the offences punishable under sections 420, 468, 469 and 506 & 34 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate at Khunti.

2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned counsel for the State.
3.
The learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioners.
4. Admitted fact is that the case arises out of a complaint.
Cognizance has been taken and summons has also been issued.
There is no necessity of taking the petitioners in custody.
Further there is no question of custodial interrogation also.
